premise: Four-year-old Deniz wants to park his small yellow toy truck on top of the courtyard's low wooden platform, and he solves it by building a cardboard ramp held steady with a small wooden block.

beats.beat: Deniz stands in the courtyard holding his small yellow toy truck and decides he wants to park it on top of the low wooden platform.
He tries to lift and push the truck straight up the platform's vertical step; the step is too tall, the truck tips and rolls back down to his feet.
He looks around and spots the flat cardboard near the courtyard wall and the small wooden block near the platform.
He drags the cardboard rectangle across the courtyard to the platform.
He leans one end of the cardboard onto the platform top; when he lets go, the cardboard slides down flat to the ground.
He carries the small wooden block over, props it against the bottom of the platform step, and lays the cardboard over it so it stays slanted like a ramp.
He steps back, pushes the truck fast up the cardboard ramp, and the truck rolls up and onto the platform top.
The truck sits parked on the platform; Deniz claps, shouts 'Vroom, parked!', and drives it in happy little circles on top.

assumptions.text: Deniz can drag the cardboard and carry the small wooden block by himself.
assumptions.why_safe: Ordinary transient effort with objects already in the packet; invents no new canon, helpers, or owned items.

assumptions.text: The sturdy flat cardboard can lean against the step as a ramp without bending.
assumptions.why_safe: Rests on the packet fact that the cardboard is sturdy and flat; no new object or world rule created.

assumptions.text: The platform has a flat top wide enough to park the truck.
assumptions.why_safe: A platform naturally implies a flat top; consistent with location.low_platform, no new durable canon.

assumptions.text: Deniz talks out loud to himself and his truck while playing.
assumptions.why_safe: Transient play dialogue typical of a 4-year-old; adds no durable canon.
